identity.title: [v0.92.1][C-SDLC v2][bug] Reject stacked closing publication without a GitHub closing relation

values.task_boundary: Repair the typed C-SDLC v2 publication/readback path so stacked PRs without a GitHub closing relation cannot be recorded as terminal closing publication.
deliverables: Closing-mode publish guard that requires exact live closingIssuesReferences linkage
Typed publish/PR-state agreement on linked_issue, linkage_source, base, head, and linkage mode
Explicit fail-closed guidance for stacked/non-default-base closing publication without a GitHub relation
Regression test for the PR #644 shape
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Closing-mode publication fails closed when live GitHub readback does not expose the target issue through closingIssuesReferences.
AC-2: A non-default stack-base PR cannot be recorded as closing publication unless GitHub reports the exact closing relation.
AC-3: Typed publish result and typed PR-state result agree on linked_issue, linkage_source, base, head, and linkage mode.
AC-4: Stacked checkpoint work has explicit non-closing/dependency mode and cannot masquerade as terminal closing authority.
AC-5: The failure message tells the operator whether to wait for the dependency branch merge, publish against the default branch, or choose the non-closing checkpoint route.
AC-6: A regression test covers the PR #644 shape: body starts with Closes #631, base is non-default, and GitHub closing relation is absent.
dependencies: Current C-SDLC v2 GitHub PR-state closingIssuesReferences parser
non_goals: Do not merge, retarget, or otherwise mutate PR #644
Do not close or rewrite issue #631 lifecycle truth
Do not replace GitHub closingIssuesReferences authority with body parsing
Do not implement C-SDLC v3 publication cutover
Do not run live provider, AWS, paid, or big-runner validation
